recommendation: Keep the commit as-is for FHIR-51886. No further FHIR core source work is needed for the seed; a separate workflow can decide the later FHIR-54232/FHIR-54985 ballot trackers if desired.
issue_request: FHIR-51886 is an Applied/Persuasive PA change request for R6 asking to repair the Appointment.class binding link from https://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/EncounterClass to https://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/encounter-class.
initial_application: No prior source commit mentioning FHIR-51886 was found. FHIR-32341 migrated Appointment.class and Encounter.class to the THO EncounterClass value set using the uppercase URL, and FHIR-39147 later corrected Encounter.class to the lowercase URL but did not touch Appointment.class. The active Appointment source still contained the broken URL before this reconciliation.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists appointment=Appointment in the active resources section, so source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml is in current build scope. PA 2025-08-26 minutes record a 4-0-0 motion to repair FHIR-51886. Later FHIR-54232 and duplicate FHIR-54985 report the same Appointment.class broken link, but they were not separately decided because FHIR-54232 is only Resolved - change required and the default run scope is Applied/Published issues.
reconciliation: Updated source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml and source/appointment/appointment.svg to use http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/encounter-class. The SVG edit was included only to keep the checked-in resource diagram consistent with the authoritative StructureDefinition source fix.
